name: app_state_init
comment: Boot: list_sel/list_top=1, load names + calibration from SPI flash, default program records for G1/G2, pb7 duty 1

name: name_set
comment: (slot, str): copy up to 60 chars into name_table slot, zero-fill

name: program_dump_g1
comment: Reply on USART1: header + count frequencies of stored program as decimal 'v,' list

name: program_dump_g2
comment: Same on USART2

name: steptable_dump_g1
comment: Reply on USART1: first 200 u16 step params of stored program (only 200 of 400)

name: steptable_dump_g2
comment: Same on USART2

name: cal_apply_test
comment: Send generator test signal set for cal_index (uses pow() for freq 2^n*200000+8 and amplitude 10^(n/3))

name: cal_apply_test_jig
comment: Variant of cal_apply_test with waveform cmds (w20/w21/w36/w37), used by USART3 ':b'

name: program_runner_tick
comment: Per-loop treatment program engine for G1 and G2: step = elapsed/(dwell*100)+1, send step commands, end/loop handling

name: ui_render
comment: Screen renderer: full redraw by ui_state when ui_flags&2, else only incremental tail (bl 0x0800773E used as tail-jump)

name: ui_render_incremental
comment: Tail of ui_render: marquee redraw, PC-mode dirty fields, ui_prev_state/marquee_prev_offset update, clear redraw flag

name: ui_render_nostate
comment: ui_render path for states without a screen (falls into ui_render_incremental)

# address: # --- compiler runtime used by the application (Keil fplib / mathlib) ---
# --- internal-flash words in the bootloader page ---

name: ui_prev_state
comment: u8: ui_state rendered last (RW_Data start)

name: key_hold_count
comment: u8: +1 per 25.6 ms while key_event >= 0x11

name: ui_flags
comment: u16: 2 redraw,4 marquee,8 list->G2,0x10 list up,0x20 PC name toggle,0x40/0x80 run G1/G2,0x100/0x200 loop,0x400/0x800 line pending,0x1000/0x2000 sync,0x4000 PC unlock,0x8000 erase-all done

name: pc_flags
comment: u16: 1/2/4/8 PC freq fields clean,0x10/0x20 names clean,0x40..0x200 w15 values,0x400 licence failure

name: misc_flags
comment: u16: bit0 cal edit inverted, bits1..4 PC-mode output enabled (G1o1,G1o2,G2o1,G2o2)

name: factory_cmd_flags
comment: u16: bit0 USART3 factory command pending

name: key_event
comment: u8: key code, |0x10 held, |0x20 short release, |0x40 long release

name: ui_state
comment: u8: 0 boot,1 HOME,2 LIST,3 CH1,4 CH2,0x10 PC mode,0xFF calibration

name: g1_prog_slot
comment: u8: program slot loaded in G1 (0 = none)

name: g2_prog_slot
comment: u8: program slot loaded in G2 (0 = none)

name: list_top
comment: u8: first visible list entry

name: list_sel
comment: u8: selected list entry 1..30

name: g1_elapsed
comment: u32: G1 run time in 10.1 ms units (0 fresh, 1 stopped)

name: g2_elapsed
comment: u32: G2 run time in 10.1 ms units

name: pc_g1_out1_freq
comment: u64: PC-mode G1 out1 frequency (w24 sniffed on USART1)

name: pc_g1_out2_freq
comment: u64: PC-mode G1 out2 frequency (w25)

name: pc_g2_out1_freq
comment: u64: PC-mode G2 out1 frequency (w24 on USART2)

name: pc_g2_out2_freq
comment: u64: PC-mode G2 out2 frequency (w25 on USART2)

name: g1_step_freq
comment: u64: frequency of current G1 step (encoded m*10+exp)

name: g2_step_freq
comment: u64: frequency of current G2 step

name: g1_step
comment: u8: current G1 step (1-based)

name: g1_step_sent
comment: u8: G1 step last sent to generator, 0xFF forces resend

name: g2_step
comment: u8: current G2 step

name: g2_step_sent
comment: u8: G2 step last sent, 0xFF forces resend

name: cal_freq_exp
comment: u8: calibration test frequency selector (0, 1..9)

name: cal_ampl_exp
comment: u8: calibration test amplitude selector (0, 4..10)

name: tmp_counter
comment: u16: boot splash wait counter; scratch index in serial command handlers

name: cal_index
comment: u8: selected calibration entry 0..28

name: cal_table
comment: s16[32]: calibration values, [31]==31 marks valid

name: name_table
comment: char[32][60]: program names, slot 0 = PC G1 name, slot 31 = PC G2 name

name: g1_program
comment: G1 program record 0x668 B: u64 hdr0 wave,hdr1 ampl,hdr2 (120),dwell,count, u64 freq[200]

name: g2_program
comment: G2 program record 0x668 B

name: g1_step_params
comment: u16[400]: G1 per-step (a,b) pairs for w50/w51/w12

name: g2_step_params
comment: u16[400]: G2 per-step (a,b) pairs
